# S16 — Check licensing of Redcode standards and warriors

Find and record the licensing of the ICWS standard texts and published warriors before any of them is bundled or adapted, including whether each is compatible with pitfight's AGPL-3.0-or-later license (C32).

**Findings:** PROJECT.md Dependency / licensing notes · **Size:** S · **Tree:** docs
Cites: C14 constraint: Do not bundle existing warriors until licensing is checked, C27 decision: ISA: original ISA strongly inspired by Redcode semantics

**Not in this slice:** bundling any warrior; the project's own license (decided in C32).

PROJECT.md says their licensing has to be checked before bundling any existing warriors and is not verified (C14). The starter bots are original, so v1 does not wait on this.

## Implement

- Read public sources (read-only) for the ICWS'94 text and commonly published warriors; record the license or terms for each with a citation.
